visual_specs.title: SkyHarbor Air Context Strength Snapshot
visual_specs.purpose: Show which dimensions have planning-grade context versus certified evidence across the enterprise.
data_requirements: Dimension-level evidence classification: planning-grade or certified
visual_specs.why_chart_allowed_or_not: No certified numeric evidence exists; qualitative classification is the appropriate representation.
visual_specs.placement: Home page hero section above story blocks
visual_specs.evidence_boundary: All classifications are planning-grade; no dimension is certified without Tower validation.

visual_specs.title: Dimension Readiness Matrix: Evidence vs. Decision-Grade Status
visual_specs.purpose: Map all twenty dimensions against evidence completeness and decision-grade readiness.
visual_specs.why_chart_allowed_or_not: Qualitative matrix is appropriate; no numeric completeness scores are certified.
visual_specs.placement: Knowledge page primary view below overview block
visual_specs.evidence_boundary: Readiness ratings are hypothesis-grade until Tower validation is completed per dimension.

visual_specs.title: Top Evidence Requests Blocking Decision-Grade Readiness
visual_specs.purpose: Surface the highest-priority evidence gaps preventing board-defensible decisions across all domains.
data_requirements: Ranked evidence gaps by decision impact
visual_specs.why_chart_allowed_or_not: Ranked qualitative cards are appropriate; no numeric priority scores are validated.
visual_specs.placement: Home page below context strength snapshot
visual_specs.evidence_boundary: Rankings are advisory and planning-grade; Tower must validate priority ordering.

visual_specs.title: Risk and Control Gap Heatmap Across Operational Domains
visual_specs.purpose: Highlight where risk exposure is highest and control evidence is weakest across airline operations.
data_requirements: Risk domain classification per use case
Human-in-the-loop gate status per AI use case
visual_specs.why_chart_allowed_or_not: No certified risk scores exist; qualitative heatmap cells are appropriate representation.
visual_specs.placement: Knowledge page dimension 11 Risks and Controls section
visual_specs.evidence_boundary: All risk ratings are planning-grade hypotheses; no certified control evidence is claimed.

visual_specs.title: AI and Analytics Use Case Portfolio: Readiness vs. Evidence Status
visual_specs.purpose: Position each use case by evidence readiness and decision-grade status across the portfolio.
data_requirements: Evidence gap count per use case
Planning-grade versus certified status per use case
visual_specs.why_chart_allowed_or_not: No certified readiness scores exist; qualitative positioning cards are appropriate.
visual_specs.placement: Knowledge page dimension 10 AI and Automation section
visual_specs.evidence_boundary: All use cases are planning-grade; none are certified for production deployment.

visual_specs.title: Vendor Dependency Matrix: Concentration and Contract Risk
visual_specs.purpose: Map vendor relationships by system criticality and contract risk across managed-services and platform domains.
data_requirements: Exit rights and benchmarking status per agreement
visual_specs.why_chart_allowed_or_not: No certified contract or spend data exists; qualitative matrix is the appropriate representation.
visual_specs.placement: Knowledge page dimension 07 Vendors and Contracts section
visual_specs.evidence_boundary: All classifications are planning-grade; legal validation of exit and benchmarking rights is not yet evidenced.

visual_specs.title: Data Foundation Gap Map: Lineage and Certification Status by Domain
visual_specs.purpose: Show where data lineage is uncertified and which domains block analytics and AI use case advancement.
data_requirements: Data domain name and owning system
Blocking use cases per uncertified domain
visual_specs.why_chart_allowed_or_not: No certified lineage evidence exists; qualitative gap map is the appropriate representation.
visual_specs.placement: Knowledge page dimension 05 Data Assets and Integrations section
visual_specs.evidence_boundary: All lineage statuses are planning-grade; Tower validation is required before any domain is certified.

visual_specs.title: Program Readiness Matrix: Baseline and Control Artifact Status
visual_specs.purpose: Show which programs have co-existing baseline and control artifacts versus those that are sponsor-only.
visual_specs.why_chart_allowed_or_not: No certified program baselines exist; qualitative matrix is the appropriate representation.
visual_specs.placement: Knowledge page dimension 09 Programs and Initiatives section
visual_specs.evidence_boundary: All program statuses are planning-grade; joint baseline and control artifact are not yet evidenced.

visual_specs.title: Nexus Module Next Actions: Where Each Module Should Act
visual_specs.purpose: Guide executives to the right Nexus module for each priority evidence or decision action.
visual_specs.why_chart_allowed_or_not: Module actions are qualitative advisory guidance; no numeric prioritization is certified.
visual_specs.placement: Home page below top evidence requests section
visual_specs.evidence_boundary: Module actions are advisory and planning-grade; Tower must validate before any action is executed.

visual_specs.title: Value Hypothesis vs. Proof: Use Case Evidence Maturity
visual_specs.purpose: Contrast the value hypothesis for each use case against the proof evidence currently available.
data_requirements: Current proof evidence status per use case
Gap between hypothesis and proof per use case
visual_specs.why_chart_allowed_or_not: No realized value or measured outcomes exist; qualitative contrast cards are appropriate.
visual_specs.placement: Knowledge page dimension 10 AI and Automation section alongside use case portfolio
visual_specs.evidence_boundary: All value hypotheses are planning-grade; no realized savings or outcomes are claimed.

visual_specs.title: Sourcing Scope Readiness Map: AMS and IMS Evidence Status
visual_specs.purpose: Show which sourcing scope elements are evidence-ready versus blocked by unreconciled data.
visual_specs.why_chart_allowed_or_not: No certified sourcing scope or spend data exists; qualitative readiness map is appropriate.
visual_specs.placement: Knowledge page dimension 17 Managed Services Scope section
visual_specs.evidence_boundary: All scope elements are planning-grade; CMDB, SLA, and invoice reconciliation are not yet evidenced.

visual_specs.title: CXO Insight Cards: Priority Signals by Executive Domain
visual_specs.purpose: Surface the most critical planning-grade signals for enterprise strategy, finance, and operations leaders.
visual_specs.why_chart_allowed_or_not: Signals are qualitative interview-derived; no certified numeric evidence supports chart representation.
visual_specs.placement: Home page footer section as a persistent executive reference
visual_specs.evidence_boundary: All signals are planning-grade and interview-derived; none are certified operational findings.
